say:0:1123101001:0.text: No! You have no right to refuse us!

say:1:1123101002:0.text: You are depriving us of our final glory!
say:1:1123101002:0.source_cn: 你这是剥夺我们最后的荣耀！

say:2:1123101003:0.text: When the storm recedes, dust will return to the desert.
say:2:1123101003:0.source_cn: 风暴退去之时，尘土终将回归沙海

say:3:1123101004:0.text: It's time for us to leave.

say:1:1123102001:1.text: You and I both know, Kruger. Hmph, perhaps it's now appropriate to say... Chief Kruger.
say:1:1123102001:1.source_cn: 你和我都清楚，克鲁格大人。\n哼，也许现在应该说……克...

say:2:1123102002:1.text: Not dying on the battlefield is already tragic. Remaining here only brings us further humiliation.
say:2:1123102002:1.source_cn: 不能战死沙场已经是我们的遗憾了，继续留在这里只会让我们...

say:4:1123102003:1.text: Calm down, Kepa. Chief Kruger means no harm...
say:4:1123102003:1.source_cn: 冷静点，奎帕。\n克鲁格族长没有恶意……

say:6:1123102004:1.text: No harm? Then why did Hashir leave? You know the reason.
say:6:1123102004:1.source_cn: 没有恶意？哈什尔是怎么离开的，你应该清楚的吧。

say:9:1123102006:1.text: Everyone, I understand your grievances. Please return for now. I will provide an explanation in due course.
say:9:1123102006:1.source_cn: 各位，我明白你们的诉求。请先回去吧，我会给你们一个交代。

say:14:1123102008:1.text: They want to uphold tradition and live as they wish.
say:14:1123102008:1.source_cn: 他们想要遵循传统，按照希望的那样生活……

choice_prompt:15:1123102008.text: They want to uphold tradition and live as they wish.
choice_prompt:15:1123102008.source_cn: 他们想要遵循传统，按照希望的那样生活……

say:17:1123102011:1.text: To come into old age is considered shameful in the Grimmaw Clan. Ever since the first elder chose self-exile, this twisted belief has taken root.
say:17:1123102011:1.source_cn: 衰老在黑嚎氏族被视为一种耻辱，自第一个老人选择自我放逐...

say:18:1123102012:1.text: In time, the elders have regarded exile as a source of pride. Perhaps I shouldn't have consented to Hashir's exile.
say:18:1123102012:1.source_cn: 慢慢这些老人竟视放逐为荣誉。\n也许我不该默许哈什尔的放逐。

choice_prompt:19:1123102012.text: In time, the elders have regarded exile as a source of pride. Perhaps I shouldn't have consented to Hashir's exile.
choice_prompt:19:1123102012.source_cn: 慢慢这些老人竟视放逐为荣誉。\n也许我不该默许哈什尔的放逐。

say:20:1123102013:1.text: A respected shaman... His deeds warrant the care and support of the Grimmaw Clan, yet he continues to insist on isolation.
say:20:1123102013:1.source_cn: 一位在氏族中较有威望的萨满，他的功绩足够安享黑嚎的供养...

say:21:1123102014:1.text: He paid no heed to my refusal and left in secret. Despite my repeated attempts to visit him, I was turned away each time.
say:21:1123102014:1.source_cn: 他最后竟无视我的拒绝，私下离开了。我曾数次拜访他，但都...

say:22:1123102015:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?
say:22:1123102015:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?
say:22:1123102015:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?

choice_prompt:23:1123102015.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?
choice_prompt:23:1123102015.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，或许有些突然，你能替我探望这位长者一次吗？
choice_prompt:23:1123102015.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?
choice_prompt:23:1123102015.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?

say:25:1123102018:1.text: If Hashir can change his mind, perhaps others may change as well.
say:25:1123102018:1.source_cn: 如果哈什尔的想法有所改观，也许能影响更多人接受改变。

say:27:1123102019:0.text: He lives in a tent in seclusion on a nearby mountain. Here are some provisions. Please deliver them to him.
say:27:1123102019:0.source_cn: 他隐居在附近的山上，自己搭了一个帐篷居住。这里是一些补...
say:27:1123102019:0.male: He lives in a tent in seclusion on a nearby mountain. Here are some provisions. Please deliver them to him.
say:27:1123102019:0.female: He lives in a tent in seclusion on a nearby mountain. Here are some provisions. Please deliver them to him.

say:29:1123102017:1.text: I must reassure the three who just left, so I'm counting on you!
say:29:1123102017:1.source_cn: 我得先去安抚刚刚的三位，所以拜托你了！
say:29:1123102017:1.male: I must reassure the three who just left, so I'm counting on you!
say:29:1123102017:1.female: I must reassure the three who just left, so I'm counting on you!

choice:23:1:2.text: It's best if you try again.
choice:23:1:2.male: It's best if you try again.
choice:23:1:2.female: It's best if you try again.

say:30:1123102010:1.text: In the Grimmaw Clan, ultimate honor is achieved by falling in battle.
say:30:1123102010:1.source_cn: 在黑嚎氏族中，最高的荣誉永远是战死沙场。

say:0:1123103001:0.text: The Grimmaw Clan is so brutal! Such a cruel tradition!
say:0:1123103001:0.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族真是可怕，竟然有这么残酷的传统！

say:1:1123103002:0.text: Perhaps it stems from the desert itself. Let's head out.
say:1:1123103002:0.source_cn: 或许跟沙漠的环境有关吧，我们先过去瞧瞧。
say:1:1123103002:0.male: Perhaps it stems from the desert itself. Let's head out.
say:1:1123103002:0.female: Perhaps it stems from the desert itself. Let's head out.

say:2:1123104001:1.text: According to Kruger, the elder is secluded somewhere in the mountains... That must be Hashir.
say:2:1123104001:1.source_cn: 山中……老人……按克鲁格说的，这个人应该就是哈什尔了。

say:3:1123104002:1.text: Is he okay? Why does he seem so still?!
say:3:1123104002:1.source_cn: 他还好吗！怎么感觉一动不动的！

say:3:1123105002:1.text: Seems like he didn't hear you. Let's use <style="highlight">War Dance</style> to catch his attention!
say:3:1123105002:1.source_cn: 该不会是听力不好吧？再使用<style=highlig...

say:1:1123106001:1.text: Stop being so noisy! Just take what you want! No need to disturb an old man at death's door.
say:1:1123106001:1.source_cn: 吵死了！想拿什么就拿吧！何必打扰我这将死的老人。

say:3:1123106002:1.text: Hey! You can hear us, after all! But wait, we aren't thieves!
say:3:1123106002:1.source_cn: 什么！原来你听得见！啊！不对，我们才不是强盗！

say:4:1123106003:1.text: Thieves... Hmph! Even if you were here to steal, I have nothing you can take anyway.
say:4:1123106003:1.source_cn: 强盗，哼。\n就算你们想抢，对于我来说也没有什么真正能...

choice_prompt:6:1123106003.text: Thieves... Hmph! Even if you were here to steal, I have nothing you can take anyway.
choice_prompt:6:1123106003.source_cn: 强盗，哼。\n就算你们想抢，对于我来说也没有什么真正能失去的了。

say:7:1123106004:1.text: Why does Kruger bother with me? Even if he's the chief now, I haven't been a member of the Grimmaw Clan for many years.
say:7:1123106004:1.source_cn: 克鲁格与我有什么关系？即便他现在是族长，我也早就不是黑...

say:8:1123106005:1.text: I'm just a drop of tainted blood from the honorable Grimmaw Clan. If tainted blood flows back, it'll only infect the wound. Can't you youngsters grasp this concept?
say:8:1123106005:1.source_cn: 我不过是黑嚎氏族滴下的一滴污血罢了。\n污血再流回去也...

say:9:1123106006:1.text: Many things are impossible to undo once set in motion.
say:9:1123106006:1.source_cn: 很多事情一旦过去，就无法回头了。

say:11:1123106007:1.text: But there are many wild beasts nearby! It's too dangerous to stay here!
say:11:1123106007:1.source_cn: 可是，这附近似乎有一些野兽，留在这里好危险！

say:12:1123106008:1.text: Pah! Outlanders will never understand. Even if I return, I won't be able to contribute to the clan. If weakness and dignity cannot coexist, then I simply choose the latter.
say:12:1123106008:1.source_cn: 外族人是不会懂的，即便我回去也无法对氏族做出贡献。\n...

say:13:1123106009:1.text: Go back... This is not where you belong. If anyone asks, you never saw me.
say:13:1123106009:1.source_cn: 回去吧，这不是你们该来的，你们也没有见到过我。

choice_prompt:14:1123106009.text: Go back... This is not where you belong. If anyone asks, you never saw me.
choice_prompt:14:1123106009.source_cn: 回去吧，这不是你们该来的，你们也没有见到过我。

say:15:1123106010:1.text: Take it with you... It's of no use to me. Now leave an old man in peace!
say:15:1123106010:1.source_cn: 带走吧，就算留在这里，我也不会用的。快离开，不要再打扰...

choice:14:0:1.text: ... We'll leave this and go for now.
choice:14:0:1.male: ... We'll leave this and go for now.
choice:14:0:1.female: ... We'll leave this and go for now.

choice:6:0:1.text: Kruger asked us to come here.
choice:6:0:1.male: Kruger asked us to come here.
choice:6:0:1.female: Kruger asked us to come here.

choice:6:1:2.text: Here are supplies from the Grimmaw Clan.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我们来为你送黑嚎的补给
choice:6:1:2.male: Here are supplies from the Grimmaw Clan.
choice:6:1:2.female: Here are supplies from the Grimmaw Clan.

say:0:1123107001:0.text: It seems we have little choice... Magister, let's go back and speak to Kruger.
say:0:1123107001:0.source_cn: 好像也没有别的办法了，主人，我们先回去告诉克鲁格吧。
say:0:1123107001:0.male: It seems we have little choice... Magister, let's go back and speak to Kruger.
say:0:1123107001:0.female: It seems we have little choice... Magister, let's go back and speak to Kruger.

say:0:1123108001:0.source_cn: 弱肉强食已经不适合现在的沙漠了

say:2:1123108003:0.text: Is there really enough to eat?

say:3:1123108004:0.text: The strong and weak can survive together.
say:3:1123108004:0.source_cn: 我们仍然可以推崇强者，但并不该排斥弱者

say:1:1123109001:1.text: You've returned, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you seen Hashir? How is he?
say:1:1123109001:1.male: You've returned, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you seen Hashir? How is he?
say:1:1123109001:1.female: You've returned, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you seen Hashir? How is he?

choice_prompt:2:1123109001.text: You've returned, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you seen Hashir? How is he?
choice_prompt:2:1123109001.source_cn: 你回来了，<style=stress><player_name></style>，见到哈什尔了吗？他的情况如何？
choice_prompt:2:1123109001.male: You've returned, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you seen Hashir? How is he?
choice_prompt:2:1123109001.female: You've returned, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Have you seen Hashir? How is he?

say:3:1123109002:1.text: I knew he wouldn't fall so easily.
say:3:1123109002:1.source_cn: 我就知道他没这么快倒下。

say:5:1123109004:1.text: He's very stubborn. The Magister tried to persuade Hashir to come and speak with you, but he wouldn't budge an inch.
say:5:1123109004:1.source_cn: 但不太乐观，主人有试过劝哈什尔回来再与你谈谈，但他情绪...
say:5:1123109004:1.male: He's very stubborn. The Magister tried to persuade Hashir to come and speak with you, but he wouldn't budge an inch.
say:5:1123109004:1.female: He's very stubborn. The Magister tried to persuade Hashir to come and speak with you, but he wouldn't budge an inch.

say:7:1123109005:1.text: Actually, he was very rude to the Magister!
say:7:1123109005:1.source_cn: 还对主人说了很多不礼貌的话！
say:7:1123109005:1.male: Actually, he was very rude to the Magister!
say:7:1123109005:1.female: Actually, he was very rude to the Magister!

say:8:1123109006:1.text: We quarreled before he left, so his emotions were likely directed toward me. I hope you won't take it personally.
say:8:1123109006:1.source_cn: 他临走的时候与我闹了矛盾，情绪应该也是冲我来的，希望你...

choice_prompt:9:1123109006.text: We quarreled before he left, so his emotions were likely directed toward me. I hope you won't take it personally.
choice_prompt:9:1123109006.source_cn: 他临走的时候与我闹了矛盾，情绪应该也是冲我来的，希望你们能理解。

say:10:1123109007:1.text: There is nothing more valuable than understanding.
say:10:1123109007:1.source_cn: 没什么比理解更伟大了。
say:10:1123109007:1.male: There is nothing more valuable than understanding.
say:10:1123109007:1.female: There is nothing more valuable than understanding.

say:11:1123109009:1.text: Perhaps Hashir is just stuck in his ways? Or sees challenges we can't understand?
say:11:1123109009:1.source_cn: 也许哈什尔还有自己的想法？或者说？苦衷！

say:12:1123109010:1.text: Hmm... He's very doubtful about his ability to contribute to the clan.
say:12:1123109010:1.source_cn: 嗯……他很顾忌能否为氏族做出贡献。

say:13:1123109011:1.text: This I understand. I'm attempting to change the mindset of my people... to make them aware that time comes for us all.
say:13:1123109011:1.source_cn: 我清楚，我也正试着改变族人们的想法，至少让他们都能明白...

say:14:1123109012:1.text: Growing old is a natural part of life. Everyone, including the feeble, should be embraced. This is the only path forward.
say:14:1123109012:1.source_cn: 不光是老去，包括弱者在内的任何人都应当得到包容，只有这...

say:15:1123109013:1.text: Before I take action, might you meet with him again?
say:15:1123109013:1.source_cn: 在我做些什么之前，你们能在多探望他吗？

choice_prompt:17:1123109013.text: Before I take action, might you meet with him again?
choice_prompt:17:1123109013.source_cn: 在我做些什么之前，你们能在多探望他吗？

say:18:1123109014:1.text: I am grateful to you. The Grimmaw Clan is facing historic changes. I appreciate your help in these difficult times.
say:18:1123109014:1.source_cn: 向你感恩，黑嚎氏族正在面临历史性的改变，这并非易事，我...
say:18:1123109014:1.male: I am grateful to you. The Grimmaw Clan is facing historic changes. I appreciate your help in these difficult times.
say:18:1123109014:1.female: I am grateful to you. The Grimmaw Clan is facing historic changes. I appreciate your help in these difficult times.

say:20:1123109015:1.text: Rest assured, I would never neglect any friend who supports our clan.
say:20:1123109015:1.source_cn: 请放心，我不会亏待任何帮助过氏族的朋友。

choice:17:1:2.text: We aren't doing this for nothing.
choice:17:1:2.male: We aren't doing this for nothing.
choice:17:1:2.female: We aren't doing this for nothing.

say:21:1123109008:1.text: I apologize on behalf of my people, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:21:1123109008:1.source_cn: 代表我的族人向你道歉，<style=stress><p...
say:21:1123109008:1.male: I apologize on behalf of my people, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:21:1123109008:1.female: I apologize on behalf of my people, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:22:1123109003:1.text: Only on the surface. My people are prideful and loathe to show vulnerability.
say:22:1123109003:1.source_cn: 那只是表象，我的族人都爱争强好胜，轻易不会展露自己虚弱...
